findings: 2026 (weeks 1-7, the finalized weeks; week 8 in progress): 84/84 team-weeks comparable, 84 reproduce Sleeper's awarded points exactly (max |diff| 0.00 against tolerance 0.011), and 84/84 recomputed lineups contain exactly the players Sleeper awarded. No week contradicted, no missing scores, nothing withheld.

Before this PR, 9 of 84 recomputed lineups differed from the host's while matching its score: 7 equal-score ties broken by player id instead of by the host's lineup (one moved 1.33 points from DL to LB: week 5, roster 3), and 2 slots the host left EMPTY that the exact solver filled with a 0-point player who did not play (week 4 roster 7, week 5 roster 11), crediting a phantom start. Fixed in construction.solve_team_week (host-lineup tie-break below score resolution; host-empty slots stay empty). Scores were never affected.

Separate attribution defect found by the integrity tests: a fullback (Sleeper position FB, fantasy_positions [RB]) started at RB in week 5 (roster 11, 1.84 points) was attributed to group FB, which no slot seats, so his points vanished from every position total. Fixed in construction.group_of (falls back to the host's fantasy_positions).

2025: every one of 130 team-weeks is contradicted: the league object lists 17 starters while the host's matchups seat 22 (124 team-weeks) or 21 (6). Recomputing under the recorded 17 slots misses the host by 14.18-85.81 points on every team-week. Per owner decision D2 the season is NOT inferred: the route serves it as available=false, unavailableReason historical_lineup_config_unverified.

2024: every one of 130 team-weeks is contradicted: the league object says best ball, but no team-week's awarded lineup is its roster optimum (differences 7.63-151.23 points). Served unavailable the same way.
